info.title: Medieval Quest API
info.description:
Create, retrieve, update, and delete medieval quests and guilds. Includes validation, error handling, Google login, and MongoDB sessions. Quest and guild GET requests are public. POST, PUT, and DELETE require login. Any signed-in user can change quests and guilds; there are no admin or ownership restrictions.

**To sign in:** open [Google login](/auth/google) in this browser, complete sign-in, then return to /api-docs/. Do not use Try it out for Google login or its callback. The browser sends the existing session cookie automatically on same-origin requests. Do not enter a cookie or Google client secret into Authorize.

Use GET /auth/me to check your login and POST /auth/logout to sign out. Swagger adds the required X-Requested-With header to same-origin write requests.

parameters.description: Optional filter. Use exactly easy, medium, or hard.

post.description: Validates the quest fields and any supplied guild ID, saves the quest in MongoDB, and returns its new ID. Requires Google login and X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest. If an Origin header is present, it must match this API origin.

requestBody.description: Provide all six required fields. Additional fields are ignored. Omit guildId or use null for an unassigned quest. On PUT, omitting guildId clears any previous guild assignment.

get.description: Open [Google login](/auth/google) as a browser page. Do not use Try it out: this route redirects the browser to Google.
Google calls this route after sign-in with temporary code and state values. Do not call it manually or use Try it out. Passport verifies the response and establishes the login session.

302.description: Redirects to /auth/me on success, or /auth/failed on authentication failure.

500.description: An error occurred while completing sign-in.

example.message: Google sign-in was unsuccessful. Please try again.
